about: Every screen name scripts/store-screenshots.sh captures for Tenshu Drive (`captured`, from the UI tests in `uiTests`), and the names reserved for screens no pipeline captures yet (`planned`). The support pages' shot: slots may name only these; web/apex/support-pages/screens.test.ts and the screenshot script check against this file. Adding a capture means adding it here. `appearances`: the system appearances the pipeline captures every `captured` screen in (scripts/store-screenshots.sh --appearance); light is the default and the published key form, dark is keyed `…/<lang>/dark/NN-screen`, and a support page falls back to light where no dark capture is published. Docs: docs/how-to/store-screenshots.md §5.

01-files.shows: The seeded file list at the root, as a list

02-photos.shows: The Holiday 2026 folder as icons, with thumbnails

03-preview.shows: A photo opened in the preview

04-file-actions.shows: A file's actions: Share Link, Rename, Move, Delete

05-add.shows: The "+" menu: New Folder, Choose File, Choose Photo

06-share-link.shows: The Share Link sheet after Generate Link

07-empty.shows: The empty file list right after setup: "No files yet"

android.about: The Android pipeline (scripts/store-screenshots-android.sh, walk in scripts/lib/android_shots.py) captures these on a 1080x2400 phone AVD, keyed android/phone/<lang>/[dark/]NN-screen. Same names as iOS for the same screen; a name new to Android must also be listed in captured or planned above, so a number never means two screens.

01-files.shows: The Files tab after the fixture is uploaded through + → Upload (folders by Folder upload, loose files by File)

02-photos.shows: The Holiday 2026 folder as a grid of its photo thumbnails (the folder's grid toggle), as the iOS walk's icons

03-preview.shows: A photo opened in the preview

04-file-actions.shows: The preview's actions: Make available offline, Link, Move, Rename, Delete, Details & Activity

05-add.shows: The "+" sheet: Create (Folder, File) and Upload (File, Folder upload, Images)

06-share-link.shows: The Link sheet after Generate link

07-empty.shows: The Files tab right after setup: "No files here yet"

09-shared.shows: The Shared tab on My shares, listing the link 06-share-link made

landing.about: The landing page's own content set (docs/how-to/store-screenshots.md §9): a separate realm seeded from the stock-photo recipe store/fixtures/landing/manifest.json, walked by scripts/store-screenshots-android.sh --set landing (landing_shot calls) and keyed android/phonelanding/<lang>/[dark/]NN-screen — a device of its own, so it never replaces a support-page capture. Its numbers are its own; the support pages never name these.

01-files.shows: The root of a realistic Drive: photo folders, Documents, loose files

02-photos.shows: The Dolomites 2026 folder as a grid of real photo thumbnails

03-preview.shows: One stock photo opened in the preview

ios.about: The iOS twin (scripts/store-screenshots.sh --set landing): the same names and the same content, captured by landingShot calls in the UI test below over the shipping Debug app, keyed ios/iphone69landing/<lang>/[dark/]NN-screen.

01-files.shows: The root of the landing Drive, as a list

02-photos.shows: The Dolomites 2026 folder as icons, with real photo thumbnails

03-preview.shows: One stock photo opened in the preview

08-uploading.shows: Drive in the browser while a file uploads

09-shared.shows: The Shared tab, listing a share link (Android captures it; the iOS walk does not)
